We consider the open-loop transfer function \(L(s)=G_c(s)G_p(s)\), with
\[
G_p(s)=\frac{1.8e^{-2.5s}}{12s+1}
\]
(time in minutes), and valve/measurement \(=1\).

---

## (a) Ultimate frequency \(\omega_u\) for P-only control (phase \(-180^\circ\))

For \(G_p(j\omega)\), the phase is the sum of the first-order lag and deadtime phases:
\[
\angle G_p(j\omega)= -\tan^{-1}(12\omega) - (2.5)\omega
\]
Set \(\angle G_p(j\omega_u)=-\pi\):
\[
\tan^{-1}(12\omega_u)+2.5\omega_u=\pi
\]
Solving numerically gives:
\[
\omega_u \approx 0.677\ \text{rad/min}
\]

---

## (b) Ultimate gain \(K_u\)

At \(\omega_u\), for sustained oscillation with proportional-only gain \(K_u\):
\[
|K_u G_p(j\omega_u)|=1 \;\;\Rightarrow\;\; K_u=\frac{1}{|G_p(j\omega_u)|}
\]
Magnitude of the plant (delay has unit magnitude):
\[
|G_p(j\omega)|=\frac{1.8}{\sqrt{1+(12\omega)^2}}
\]
At \(\omega_u=0.677\):
\[
|G_p|=\frac{1.8}{\sqrt{1+(12\cdot 0.677)^2}}
=\frac{1.8}{\sqrt{1+8.13^2}}
\approx \frac{1.8}{8.19}=0.2197
\]
Thus:
\[
K_u=\frac{1}{0.2197}\approx 4.55
\]

---

## (c) Ultimate period \(P_u\)

\[
P_u=\frac{2\pi}{\omega_u}=\frac{2\pi}{0.677}\approx 9.28\ \text{min}
\]

---

## (d) Ziegler–Nichols PI settings

Given:
\[
K_c=\frac{K_u}{2.2},\qquad \tau_I=\frac{P_u}{1.2}
\]
So:
\[
K_c=\frac{4.55}{2.2}\approx 2.07
\]
\[
\tau_I=\frac{9.28}{1.2}\approx 7.73\ \text{min}
\]

---

## (e) Gain margin for the loop with PI

Controller:
\[
G_c(s)=K_c\left(1+\frac{1}{\tau_I s}\right)
\]
For \(s=j\omega\):
\[
|G_c(j\omega)|=K_c\sqrt{1+\left(\frac{1}{\omega\tau_I}\right)^2},\qquad
\angle G_c(j\omega)=-\tan^{-1}\!\left(\frac{1}{\omega\tau_I}\right)
\]

Gain margin is evaluated at the phase crossover frequency \(\omega_{180}\) where \(\angle L(j\omega)=-\pi\):
\[
\tan^{-1}(12\omega_{180})+2.5\omega_{180}+\tan^{-1}\!\left(\frac{1}{\omega_{180}\tau_I}\right)=\pi
\]
With \(\tau_I=7.73\), solving gives:
\[
\omega_{180}\approx 0.5985\ \text{rad/min}
\]

Now compute \(|L|\) at \(\omega_{180}\):

Plant magnitude:
\[
|G_p|=\frac{1.8}{\sqrt{1+(12\omega)^2}}
=\frac{1.8}{\sqrt{1+(12\cdot0.5985)^2}}
=\frac{1.8}{7.252}\approx 0.2482
\]
Controller magnitude:
\[
|G_c|=2.07\sqrt{1+\left(\frac{1}{0.5985\cdot7.73}\right)^2}
=2.07\sqrt{1+0.216^2}\approx 2.12
\]
So:
\[
|L| \approx 0.2482(2.12)=0.525
\]
Gain margin (ratio):
\[
GM=\frac{1}{|L|}\approx \frac{1}{0.525}=1.90
\]

---

## (f) Phase margin for the same loop

Find gain crossover \(\omega_{gc}\) where \(|L(j\omega_{gc})|=1\). Solve:
\[
K_c\sqrt{1+\left(\frac{1}{\omega\tau_I}\right)^2}\cdot \frac{1.8}{\sqrt{1+(12\omega)^2}} = 1
\]
This yields:
\[
\omega_{gc}\approx 0.324\ \text{rad/min}
\]

Now phase at \(\omega_{gc}\):

Plant phase:
\[
\angle G_p = -\tan^{-1}(12\omega)-2.5\omega
= -\tan^{-1}(3.89) - 0.809
\approx -1.319 -0.809 = -2.128\ \text{rad}
\]
Controller phase:
\[
\angle G_c=-\tan^{-1}\!\left(\frac{1}{\omega\tau_I}\right)
=-\tan^{-1}(0.399)\approx -0.379\ \text{rad}
\]
Total:
\[
\angle L \approx -2.128-0.379=-2.507\ \text{rad} \approx -143.6^\circ
\]
Phase margin:
\[
PM = 180^\circ + \angle L(\omega_{gc}) = 180^\circ - 143.6^\circ = 36.4^\circ
\]

---

FINAL (a): 0.677 rad/min  
FINAL (b): 4.55 –  
FINAL (c): 9.28 min  
FINAL (d): (2.07, 7.73) (–, min)  
FINAL (e): 1.90 –  
FINAL (f): 36.4 deg
